// row: I1 of docs/tawzee.md §3 — the Electron and NW.js renderer runtime.
// why noEmit: esbuild emits this one, because the output has to be loadable twice: as a
CommonJS module the preload requires, and as a bare <script src> in the
page world on the takeover rung. An IIFE with a global name plus a guarded
module.exports footer is both; tsc's UMD emit is neither, because with no
`export as namespace` it binds nothing global when `module` is absent.
So tsc is kept for what esbuild does not do at all — type-checking.
